set.body:
Split from bd-01M2TAK2EFCDWR2A01Q3XSNS79 (H5) AC1-AC2 so that an engineering defect on the stories-alone path no longer waits behind research blockers (bd-01M2TADR4KM1S4J46HK2C3BN76, bd-01M2TAH5VA3WJBGR8WKAAH14Z8). The model the pipeline builds from real text does not validate. docs/adr/0002-visualization-contract.md §A1 records derivation gaps and violations when the 50 captured War of the Ghosts recordings are replayed, and H5 attributes the blocking errors to s43, where the provider abstained.

Acceptance:
1. An ADR 0005 amendment for typed absence on an abstained derivation is committed before the code (SD5).
2. The WOG compile from pipeline/src/test/resources/recordings/wog-captured validates, or a court names exactly which invariant refuses it and why.
3. An abstained derivation is typed absence, never a default status or weight (design contract rule 7). A mutation restoring the old behaviour fails a named test.
4. Text S0 pins are unchanged, or each change is explained.

Gate: reference-scope; SD2 checkAll with bound totals; SD6 cold review.
set.title: [story] Real-text story compile validates, or a court names why (s43 fix split from H5)
